proven: 006e9890 body 006e9890-006e9a47, every branch read from the listing.
The eleven vtables that carry it and the two that override it, by an image-wide byte scan and an uncapped 13-row xref list.
The constructor sub-type of all thirteen classes, each from its own MOV [ESI+8],imm.
+14h is the Name string data: 006e8770 stores the GetStringOrDefault result into the native string at descriptor+10h, whose data pointer is at +4.
+ACh is DamageMin and +B4h is Blast.BlastDamageMin, from the reader key table.
Every constant, decoded from its .rdata bytes.
The invocation site 006eafe0 and its four callers.
The 119-row per-class table: the reconstructed C++ reproduces an independent Python model of the rule on all 119 rows with zero mismatches.
assumed: The override selection by sub-type in the reconstruction stands in for the vtable slot. It is exact only because constructor sub-type and vtable are one-to-one BEFORE the hook runs; a caller that passes a refined sub-type (2, 3, 5, 6, 7) gets the base behaviour, which is what the native would do on a second call anyway (the latch).
006e97f0 (slot +14h) is contract: unread beyond its +C8h store. If it wrote +50h, +54h or +68h it would change what the finalise hook reads, since 006eb041 runs first.

The x87 rounding model: the native keeps intermediate products at extended precision and rounds at each FSTP float. The reconstruction uses double and casts at the same points. This is a faithful model, not a bit-exact one.
That the range is the only reason the five categories are silent. Proven sufficient, not proven exclusive.
